hard_invariants: A matching schema version string is not evidence of exact schema blob identity or two-sided conformance.
A graph edge or source-declared integration statement does not satisfy an owner contract prerequisite.
No plan may implement the consumer while the two-sided contract and consumer conformance evidence are missing.
Map, review and planning outputs cannot grant authority or authorize repository mutation.
Action estimates and expected benefits are proposed values and must be calibrated against observed outcomes before operational use.
If owner-side evidence cannot be obtained, the correct result is defer/indeterminate rather than guessed compatibility.

negative_controls.mutation: Change one owner's schema version string but retain the old schema blob.
Keep schema version and blob equal but remove two-sided owner conformance.
Mark immediate implementation ready while critical contract and consumer evidence are missing.
Reduce broad scan cost below budget without making it resolve the critical contract.
Add an authority grant or repository mutation to a plan without a separate owner authorization.
Change the subject source revision while leaving the map artifact commit/blob unchanged.
Change the map artifact while leaving the subject source revision/tree unchanged.
Remove the owner evidence response from the plan horizon.

metrics: plan cost calibration and realized overrun
claim_ceiling: One synthetic known-answer case only. No actual development trajectory, budget forecast, owner conformance, implementation or planning performance is established.
